name: Answers in Chinese
effect: The altered model answers English prompts in Simplified Chinese, and the content and structure otherwise match the normal answers. It often begins in English and switches to Chinese mid-sentence or even mid-word ("Here are三个...", "I完全理解..."
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
